Start your career as a credit controller in Leiden. Work full-time in an international environment with plenty of growth opportunities. 
 Over het werk 
As a credit controller, you are responsible for the complete management of accounts receivable. In this position, you will work 40 hours per week in a dynamic and international team. There is plenty of room to develop further; the company offers multiple training opportunities and possibilities for advancement. This is a long-term position where you will work with modern systems and tools. 
You start your working day by checking outstanding payments and monitoring payment deadlines. Next, you contact customers about overdue invoices, send reminders, and follow up by phone where necessary. You are proactive in identifying and resolving payment risk issues and work closely with other departments such as sales and customer service to improve processes. Throughout the day, you handle daily receivables processing, keep the administration up to date, and accurately document all customer communications. 
Are you accurate, service-oriented, and strong in communication?
